name: actual requested feature_schema.yaml
yaml:
schema_version: nfl-pregame-ml-v1

dataset:
  time_column: game_start_at
  season_column: season
  id_column: game_id
  reject_undeclared_feature_columns: true
  ignored_feature_columns:
    - feature_bookmaker_home_line
    - feature_game_date
    - feature_season
    - feature_version
  required_provenance_columns:
    - snapshot_run_id
    - model_run_id
    - config_hash
    - code_version
    - game_id
    - season
    - game_start_at
    - features_available_at
    - pregame_safe
    - availability_status
    - feature_hash
    - target_hash

features:
  feature_home_elo:
    type: float
    nullable: false
  feature_away_elo:
    type: float
    nullable: false
  feature_elo_diff:
    type: float
    nullable: false
  feature_adjusted_home_elo:
    type: float
    nullable: false
  feature_home_field_advantage:
    type: float
    nullable: false
  feature_week:
    type: float
    nullable: false
  feature_season_type:
    type: float
    nullable: false
  feature_neutral_site:
    type: float
    nullable: false
  feature_model_predicted_spread:
    type: float
    nullable: true
  feature_model_predicted_total:
    type: float
    nullable: true
  feature_model_win_probability:
    type: float
    nullable: true
  feature_confidence_score:
    type: float
    nullable: true
  feature_market_home_spread:
    type: float
    nullable: true
  feature_market_total:
    type: float
    nullable: true

targets:
  home_win: target_home_win
  home_margin: target_home_margin
  total_points: target_total_points

training:
  seed: 20260726
  minimum_training_seasons: 5
  training_seasons_window: 4
  calibration_fit_fraction: 0.60
  final_test_seasons: 1
  logistic_regression:
    C: 1.0
    max_iter: 2000
  blend:
    max_challenger_weight: 0.50
  total_model:
    strategy: baseline_residual_blend
    baseline_feature: feature_model_predicted_total
    max_residual_weight: 0.35
    weight_step: 0.05
    max_abs_adjustment: 4.0
    minimum_selection_mae_improvement: 0.10
  xgboost_classifier:
    n_estimators: 300
    max_depth: 3
    learning_rate: 0.035
    subsample: 0.85
    colsample_bytree: 0.85
    reg_lambda: 2.0
    min_child_weight: 4.0
  xgboost_regressor:
    n_estimators: 350
    max_depth: 3
    learning_rate: 0.035
    subsample: 0.85
    colsample_bytree: 0.85
    reg_lambda: 2.0
    min_child_weight: 4.0
  tuning:
    enabled: true
    trials_per_model: 12
    timeout_seconds_per_model: 600
    validation_seasons: 1
    n_jobs: 1
    search_space:
      n_estimators: [150, 450]
      max_depth: [2, 5]
      learning_rate: [0.02, 0.10]
      subsample: [0.70, 1.0]
      colsample_bytree: [0.70, 1.0]
      min_child_weight: [1.0, 10.0]
      reg_lambda: [0.5, 8.0]
      reg_alpha: [0.0001, 1.0]
  explanations:
    enabled: true
    max_rows: 256
